source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in ones), max(r for r, c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in ones), max(c for r, c in ones)
    box = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    bh, bw = len(box), len(box[0])
    outside = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != 0 and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    common_row = next(r for r in set(r for r, c in outside)
                      if sum(rr == r for rr, cc in outside) == 2)
    common_col = next(c for c in set(c for r, c in outside)
                      if sum(cc == c for rr, cc in outside) == 2)
    corner = (common_row, common_col)
    horiz = next((r, c) for r, c in outside if r == common_row and c != common_col)
    vert = next((r, c) for r, c in outside if c == common_col and r != common_row)
    hd = 1 if horiz[1] > common_col else -1
    vd = 1 if vert[0] > common_row else -1
    if hd < 0 and vd > 0:  # left and down: reflect across anti-diagonal
        out = [[0] * bh for _ in range(bw)]
        for r in range(bh):
            for c in range(bw):
                out[bw - 1 - c][bh - 1 - r] = box[r][c]
    elif hd > 0 and vd > 0:  # right and down: reflect across main diagonal
        out = [[box[r][c] for r in range(bh)] for c in range(bw)]
    elif hd < 0 and vd < 0:  # left and up: reflect across horizontal axis
        out = box[::-1]
    else:
        raise ValueError("unseen marker orientation")
    return out
'''
pfile=program_dir/'task-e805e1e0.py'
pfile.write_text(source)
print(pfile, pfile.exists())
